feed.title: FrontendHelpers — what's new
feed.subtitle: New tools, guides and fixes on FrontendHelpers.

entry.title: Two new tools and faster pages
entry.content:
• New: Colour converter: hex, RGB, HSL, HWB and OKLCH, with WCAG contrast and an sRGB gamut check
  • New: Cubic-bezier easing generator: drag the curve, preview it, copy cubic-bezier() or a linear() version
  • Improved: Faster pages: one variable font file per typeface instead of duplicates, deferred scripts, minified and long-cached CSS

entry.title: Four more effect recipes and keyboard fixes
entry.content:
• New: Hover underline animations, including one that survives links wrapping onto two lines
  • New: 3D flip cards that work with hover, keyboard focus and a button
  • New: Animating accordion height to auto: grid rows, interpolate-size and ::details-content
  • New: Animating the native dialog element in and out with @starting-style
  • Fixed: The Smooth Accordion and Hamburger Morph animations can now be operated from the keyboard

entry.title: Eight in-depth CSS effect recipes
entry.content:
• New: CSS typewriter effect: the steps() and ch technique, multi-line typing and when to use JavaScript instead
  • New: Skeleton loading screens: layout-matched placeholders, a compositor-friendly shimmer and accessible loading states
  • New: Animated gradient borders: three techniques compared, animated with @property
  • New: Shake animation for form errors, with an accessible, reduced-motion-friendly version
  • New: CSS loading spinners: three lightweight techniques, delayed display and an accessible status
  • New: Fade in on scroll with CSS scroll-driven animations, plus a safe IntersectionObserver fallback
  • New: Animated gradient text that stays readable: contrast, forced colours and reduced motion
  • New: An infinite CSS marquee with a seamless loop and a proper pause control

entry.title: A new tool, three guides and an accuracy overhaul
entry.content:
• New: CSS clamp() generator: fluid font sizes and type scales, with a check that 200% browser zoom still works
  • New: Guide: fluid typography with clamp(), with worked maths and zoom results
  • New: Guide: WCAG 2.2 colour contrast for developers, with 17 real colour pairs tested
  • New: Guide: robots.txt vs noindex vs canonical, and which to use when
  • Improved: The homepage is now a directory of every tool, with a quick filter
  • Improved: Rewrote the developer notes on all 16 tool pages; every code sample was run before publishing
  • Improved: Every animation's markup and CSS is now written out on its category page, and the JS tips library reads without JavaScript
  • Improved: Every page is available as Markdown for AI assistants and coding agents (add .md to any URL)
  • Improved: Microsoft Clarity now loads only after you accept cookies, and the privacy and cookie policies describe exactly what loads
  • Improved: Accessibility: labels on every form control, reduced-motion support and corrected heading levels
  • Fixed: Around twenty factual errors across tools and guides, including what Search Console's "Discovered – currently not indexed" status means
  • Fixed: The slug, text case and keyword tools now handle accented and non-English text (Straße → strasse, café stays café)

entry.title: First guides published
entry.content: • New: Six practical guides: indexing problems, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, dark mode, CSS animation performance and a launch checklist

entry.title: FrontendHelpers launched
entry.content: • New: Free browser-based SEO and CSS tools, a copy-paste CSS animation library, JavaScript tips, Dev Essentials and a React vs Angular comparison
